# QuickTrust
> Compliance automation platform with implementation engineers

## About
QuickTrust is a compliance automation platform built by GPT Innovations, Inc.
Unlike pure-software tools, QuickTrust combines an intelligent platform with
security/DevOps engineers who implement controls, close gaps, and coordinate
with auditors — so you get certified faster with minimal internal lift.

## Frameworks Supported
- SOC 2 Type I & II (Trust Services Criteria)
- ISO 27001 (Information Security Management)
- ISO 42001 (AI Governance)
- HIPAA (Healthcare Compliance)
- HITRUST (Healthcare Security)
- PCI DSS (Payment Security)
- GDPR (Data Protection)
- Custom Frameworks

## Core Capabilities
- Question → Policy → Control mapping for any security questionnaire
- Automated policy gap detection and remediation planning
- Evidence collection, organization, and auditor-ready portal
- Security/DevOps engineer implementation (IAM, logging, encryption, SDLC)
- Continuous compliance monitoring and drift detection
- Audit coordination and readiness scoring

## Key Stats
- 100% audit pass rate across 100+ audits
- Audit-ready in 6-10 weeks (fastest: 8 weeks)
- 90% reduction in engineering time for compliance
- Platform + engineers model (unique in market)

## Key Differentiator
Platform + implementation team. QuickTrust engineers actually implement
the controls (IAM, SIEM, encryption, CI/CD security, etc.) — not just
advise. Audit-ready in weeks, not months.

## Who It's For
- B2B SaaS companies (Seed to Series C)
- Healthcare technology companies
- Fintech companies
- Any company needing compliance certification to close enterprise deals

## Primary Solutions
- Audit readiness acceleration
- Security questionnaire automation
- Evidence collection and management
- Continuous compliance monitoring
- Gap analysis and remediation
